description: Free, read-only. Fetch a page and return its HTML minus scripts, styles, svg, iframes, comments and inline handlers; tags and attributes stay, so structure is readable. For inspecting or rebuilding markup, not plain text (fetch_extract gives that). Runs no JavaScript: SPAs return an empty shell. Cut at maxChars with a marker.

url.description: http(s) page URL. Private addresses are refused.

name: fetch_html
title: Fetch raw HTML
